scenes.setting: In the sewer dark: a Specter's Shriek, the Dark Emperor's freezing touch that suppresses a shadow by natural order, and two Holy Lights from the Sun Brooch evaporate the Sequence 5 Devil — then the black crown vanishes with his spirit just as the blood-stained silver armor arrives. 'Clearing clues and destroying evidence?'
scenes.text_anchor: This Sequence 5 expert who had just assassinated a duke had died just like that.

scenes.setting: Above the gray fog, questioning the fading spirit: Duke Negan's assassination was commissioned by an ancient organization that bends the times toward the Creator's resurrection, paying with a Card of Blasphemy — the Abyss card — and it has a name: the Twilight Hermit Order

In the villa, the grieving secretary gives his name — Lockhart Siakam, Sequence 5 — swears no one knew the Duke's plans and suspects nobody; then, alone over the corpse, he says 'I'm sorry', smiles with his back to the room, and thinks: this is the choice of the times
scenes.text_anchor: “This is the choice of the times…”
